lab: Example teaching lab (demo SOP — replace with your own)
title: No ethidium bromide
rule: Ethidium bromide is not used in this lab. Stain agarose gels with SYBR Safe, and dispose of SYBR Safe gels as the manufacturer directs.

lab: Example teaching lab (demo SOP — replace with your own)
title: LB means LB Miller here
rule: When a protocol says "LB" without naming a variant, make LB Miller (10 g/L NaCl). Use Lennox or Luria only when a protocol names them.

lab: Example teaching lab (demo SOP — replace with your own)
title: Never autoclave bleach
rule: Liquid waste that has been treated with bleach is never autoclaved. Once the contact time is over, pour it into the chemical waste carboy instead.

lab: Example teaching lab (demo SOP — replace with your own)
title: Pre-PCR and post-PCR stay apart
rule: Set up PCR on ice at the pre-PCR bench. No amplified product, gel or used tips go into the pre-PCR area.

lab: Example teaching lab (demo SOP — replace with your own)
title: Fill autoclave vessels two-thirds at most
rule: Never fill a vessel more than two-thirds full for autoclaving, and loosen caps. Use the liquids cycle for media.
